dialogues.title: Long Time, No See!
dialogues.zh: 伟在艾玛家的聚会上见到老朋友，也认识了新朋友
lines: Wei! Long time, no see! Please come in.
Great to see you again, Emma!
It's really good to see you. Oh, here's Ana. Ana, meet Wei.
见到你真好。哦，安娜来了。安娜，这是伟。
Hi, Wei. Pleased to meet you.
Great to meet you, too. How do you know Emma?
我也很高兴认识你。你和艾玛是怎么认识的？
We're coworkers. And you? Are you a friend of hers?
我们是同事。你呢？你是她的朋友？
Yes. We're close friends. She's my old neighbor.
是的，我们是好朋友。她是我以前的邻居。
Do you know anybody else here?
No, I don't. I'm pretty new to this neighborhood.
不认识。我刚搬到这一带不久。
Wow! Seriously? Well, that's Carlos. He's a chef, and he's Emma's boyfriend.
哇！真的吗？那位是卡洛斯，他是厨师，也是艾玛的男朋友。
Is he really? That's good to know.

dialogues.title: Whose Is This?
dialogues.zh: 机场安检口，伟帮一位老太太找东西
lines: Excuse me! Is this umbrella yours?
打扰一下！这把伞是你的吗？
No, it's not mine. I think it belongs to that couple.
不是我的。我想是那对夫妻的。
Hmm. And whose water bottle is this?
That's mine. Sorry! Can I take it on the plane?
那是我的。抱歉！能带上飞机吗？
Only if it's empty. And this hand lotion is too big.
空的才行。还有这瓶护手霜太大了。
Oh, it isn't mine. It's hers, that woman with the little girl.
哦，那不是我的，是她的，那位带着小女孩的女士。
Yes, it's my granddaughter's. Where's my grandson's bag?
是的，是我孙女的。我孙子的包在哪儿？
Is it the blue one? There's a blue bag over there.
是蓝色那个吗？那边有个蓝包。
Yes, that's his! Thanks so much.

dialogues.title: A New Coworker
dialogues.zh: 伟换了新工作，第一天上班
lines: Pleased to meet you. I'm Jake, your coworker. This is your desk, right here.
很高兴认识你。我是杰克，你的同事。这是你的桌子，就在这儿。
Great to meet you, too. This is a nice office.
我也很高兴认识你。这个办公室真不错。
Thanks. That's Ms. Patel. She's the boss. Her office is across from your desk.
谢谢。那位是帕特尔女士，她是老板。她的办公室就在你桌子对面。
Is it really? That's good to know.
Oh, they're probably hers. She always leaves them here!
哦，那可能是她的。她总把墨镜落在这儿！

ex: My boss is from New York.
我的老板是纽约人。
vocab.why: Is she your boss? ## 她是你的上司吗？
vocab.tip: 来自荷兰语 baas（主人），荷兰移民把这个词带到了纽约。

ex: Is he your boyfriend?
他是你男朋友吗？
vocab.why: Her boyfriend is a chef. ## 她男朋友是厨师。
vocab.tip: 男孩 + 朋友 = 男朋友。

ex: Kiko is my classmate.
纪子是我的同学。
vocab.why: My classmates are from five countries. ## 我的同学来自五个国家。

ex: Marta is my close friend.
玛尔塔是我的好朋友。
vocab.why: They're not close friends. ## 他们不是好朋友。

ex: They're a nice couple.
他们是很般配的一对。
vocab.why: The couple next door is from Texas. ## 隔壁那对夫妻是得州人。

ex: His girlfriend is a nurse.
他女朋友是护士。
vocab.why: Do you have a girlfriend? ## 你有女朋友吗？
vocab.tip: 女孩 + 朋友 = 女朋友。

ex: My grandmother has ten grandchildren.
我奶奶有十个孙辈。
vocab.why: The grandchildren visit on Sundays. ## 孙辈们周日来看望。

ex: Her granddaughter is two years old.
她的孙女两岁。
vocab.why: This is my granddaughter, Lily. ## 这是我孙女莉莉。
vocab.tip: 女儿的女儿或儿子的女儿。

ex: I think that's my grandson's bag.
我想那是我孙子的包。
vocab.why: Her grandson plays soccer. ## 她的孙子踢足球。

ex: Marcos is my neighbor.
马科斯是我的邻居。
vocab.why: Are you my new neighbor? ## 你是我的新邻居吗？

ex: I have two roommates.
我有两个室友。
vocab.why: My roommate cooks every night. ## 我室友每天晚上做饭。
vocab.tip: 住同一间房或同一套公寓的伙伴。

ex: I'm Julie, your coworker.
我是朱莉，你的同事。
vocab.why: My coworkers are very friendly. ## 我的同事都很友好。

ex: I'm her husband.
我是她丈夫。
vocab.why: Her husband works at a bank. ## 她丈夫在银行工作。

ex: Do you want a piece of my candy bar?
要吃一块我的巧克力棒吗？
vocab.why: I have a candy bar in my bag. ## 我包里有根巧克力棒。

ex: I don't have any cash.
我身上没有现金。
vocab.why: Can I pay in cash? ## 可以付现金吗？

ex: There's a photo of me on my driver's license.
我的驾照上有我的照片。
vocab.why: Can I see your driver's license? ## 可以看一下你的驾照吗？

ex: Look, there's my pack of gum.
看，那是我的那包口香糖。
vocab.why: Do you want some gum? ## 要来点口香糖吗？

ex: My hairbrush is in my bag.
我的发刷在包里。
vocab.why: Can I use your hairbrush? ## 我能用一下你的梳子吗？

ex: You can't take hand lotion on the plane.
护手霜不能带上飞机。
vocab.why: This hand lotion smells nice. ## 这个护手霜很好闻。

ex: I have a cute keychain.
我有一个很可爱的钥匙链。
vocab.why: My keys are on my keychain. ## 我的钥匙挂在钥匙链上。

ex: I have a small mirror in my bag.
我包里有一面小镜子。
vocab.why: Look in the mirror. ## 照照镜子。

ex: Here is the receipt from the restaurant.
这是餐厅的小票。
vocab.why: Can I have a receipt, please? ## 请给我一张收据。

ex: Can you give me those tissues, please?
能把那些纸巾递给我吗？
vocab.why: I always have tissues in my bag. ## 我包里总有纸巾。

ex: Is that your umbrella?
那是你的伞吗？
vocab.why: It's raining, and my umbrella is broken. ## 下雨了，可我的伞坏了。
vocab.tip: 小小的影子，原来是遮太阳的。

ex: My water bottle is empty.
我的水瓶空了。
vocab.why: Whose water bottle is this? ## 这是谁的水瓶？

ex: I need to clean my sunglasses.
我得擦擦墨镜。
vocab.why: Where are my sunglasses? ## 我的墨镜在哪儿？

ex: It belongs to me.
它是我的。
vocab.why: This bag belongs to my grandson. ## 这个包是我孙子的。

ex: It's my first time at this conference.
这是我第一次参加这个会议。
vocab.why: The conference is in Chicago. ## 会议在芝加哥举行。
vocab.tip: 大家带着想法聚到一起。

ex: I would like to do an internship in your company.
我想在贵公司实习。
vocab.why: Her internship is in the summer. ## 她的实习在夏天。

ex: I attach my résumé to this email.
随邮件附上我的简历。
vocab.why: Please send us your résumé. ## 请把你的简历发给我们。

ex: What is your email about? You need a subject!
你的邮件是关于什么的？要写主题！
vocab.why: Write a short subject. ## 写一个简短的主题。

ex: I'm pretty new to this city.
我来这个城市不太久。
vocab.why: That's pretty good. ## 挺不错的。
vocab.tip: 口语里放在形容词前，意思是“挺”。

phrases.tip: 第一次见面用 meet；回答时加 too：Great to meet you, too.

phrases.reply: I know! Great to see you again!
phrases.tip: 只对认识的人说，很口语。这句据说来自中文“好久不见”的直译。

phrases.reply: It's really good to see you, too.
sim: It's really good to see you.
phrases.tip: 见老朋友用 see，第一次见面用 meet。

phrases.reply: No, I don't. It's my first time here.
sim: Is this your first time here?
phrases.tip: 在聚会、会议上开启对话的好问题。

phrases.zh: 你和艾玛是怎么认识的？
sim: How do you two know each other?
Are you a friend of hers?
phrases.tip: 在朋友家的聚会上最常问的一句，回答说你们的关系就行。

phrases.en: Are you a friend of hers?
sim: Is she a coworker of yours?
phrases.tip: a friend of + 名词性物主代词（mine / his / hers / ours / theirs）。
表示惊讶和感兴趣。Is it really? / Are you really? 要和对方的话对应：It's new. — Is it really?
whose 和 who's（= who is）读音一样，意思不同。
yours 后面不再加名词：Is this yours?（不说 yours bag）。

sim: I think it belongs to that couple.
phrases.tip: belong to + 人：It belongs to my grandson.

phrases.en: I would like to do an internship in your company.
sim: I would like to meet you.
phrases.tip: 正式邮件里说想要什么，用 I would like…，比 I want… 礼貌。

grammar.title: be 动词和形容词性物主代词
rows: 肯定

I'm from Chengdu.
She's a student.
We're close friends.
否定

He's not my boyfriend.
They're not close friends.
疑问

Is he your classmate?
Are you my new neighbor?
— Yes, he is. / No, he's not.
物主代词

I → my　you → your　he → his
she → her　it → its　we → our　they → their
grammar.tip: 物主代词跟着“主人”变：This is my wife with her parents.（不说 their parents）。it's = it is，its = 它的。
grammar.say: He's not my boyfriend. Is he your classmate? Her name's Marta.

grammar.title: 表示所属：whose、名词性物主代词、's、belong to
rows: 问

Whose is this?
Whose water bottle is this?
名词性物主代词

mine　yours　his　hers　ours　theirs
It's not mine. I think it's hers.
名词 + 's

That's my grandson's bag.
It's my wife's umbrella.
belong to

It belongs to me.
The bag belongs to her grandson.
grammar.tip: my / your / her 后面要跟名词：my bag；mine / yours / hers 后面不跟名词：It's mine.
grammar.say: Whose is this? It's not mine. I think it's hers. It belongs to her grandson.

pron.title: 词尾的 /l/
pron.explain: 英语单词结尾的 l 要读出来：舌尖抬起，顶住上门牙后面的牙龈，声音从舌头两边出来。中国学生常把词尾的 l 读成“欧”，或干脆省掉，people 听起来像 peopo。点开听，读到最后舌尖一定要顶上去。
list: 美式 t 像轻轻的 d

grammarQuiz.q: This is my wife with ___ parents.
grammarQuiz.why: 父母是妻子的，用 her。

grammarQuiz.q: Whose umbrella is this? — It's ___.
grammarQuiz.why: 后面没有名词，用名词性物主代词 mine。

grammarQuiz.q: That's my ___ bag.
grammarQuiz.why: 名词 + 's 表示“……的”。

grammarQuiz.q: This bag ___ to my daughter.
grammarQuiz.why: belong 是动词，主语是 this bag，加 s。

grammarQuiz.q: ___ he your classmate? — No, he's not.
grammarQuiz.why: he 用 is。

grammarQuiz.q: Is this ___? — Yes, thanks!
grammarQuiz.why: 后面没有名词，用 yours。

writingTask.title: 写一封自我介绍的正式邮件
writingTask.task: 给一个你不认识的人写一封正式邮件：说明你们共同认识的人、你是谁、你写信的目的（比如想找工作、想了解信息），最后礼貌地结尾。
writingTask.focus: 大写字母：句首、人名和机构名、称谓（Mr. / Ms. / Dr.）、国家和城市、星期和月份、代词 I 都要大写。正式邮件用 Dear … 开头，用 Best wishes / Sincerely 结尾，写全名，不用表情符号。
starters: My name is … Your … is my …
Thank you very much for your time.
checklist: 有邮件主题（Subject）
用 Dear + 称谓 + 姓开头
说了你们共同认识的人
用 I would like… 说明目的
该大写的地方都大写了
用 Best wishes / Sincerely 结尾，写了全名
writingTask.model:
Subject: English classes for adults

Dear Mr. Brown,

My name is Wei Zhang. Your wife, Linda, is my neighbor in Seattle. She says you teach English at Green Lake Library.

I would like some information about your evening classes. I work Monday to Friday, so I am free on Tuesday and Thursday evenings.

Thank you very much for your time.

Best wishes,
Wei Zhang

readings.title: Subject: Summer internship at Bay Street Bakery
readings.text:
Dear Ms. Lopez,

My name is Wei Zhang. Your son, Daniel, is my classmate at Lakeview Community College in Seattle. He says your bakery is looking for help this summer.

I would like to do an internship at Bay Street Bakery in June and July. I am from Chengdu, China, and I live in Seattle now. I love bread and cakes. I bake for my roommates every weekend, and my coworkers love my green tea cookies. I also speak Chinese and some Spanish, so I can talk with many of your customers.

I attach my résumé to this email. I am free on Tuesday and Thursday afternoons, and I would like to meet you. You can call me at 206-555-0148.

Thank you very much for your time.

Best wishes,
Wei Zhang
readings.zh:
尊敬的洛佩斯女士：

我叫张伟。您的儿子丹尼尔是我在西雅图湖景社区学院的同学。他说您的面包店这个夏天需要帮手。

我想在六月和七月到湾街面包店实习。我来自中国成都，现在住在西雅图。我喜欢面包和蛋糕，每个周末都给室友们烤东西，同事们也很爱我做的抹茶饼干。我还会说中文和一点西班牙语，可以和您的很多顾客交流。

随邮件附上我的简历。我周二和周四下午有空，希望能和您见一面。您可以打 206-555-0148 联系我。

非常感谢您抽出时间。

祝好，
张伟

qs.why: "I would like to do an internship at Bay Street Bakery…"

qs.q: How does Wei know about the bakery?
opts: Ms. Lopez's son is his classmate.
qs.a: Ms. Lopez's son is his classmate.
qs.why: "Your son, Daniel, is my classmate…"

qs.q: What does Wei send with the email?
qs.why: "I attach my résumé to this email."

qs.q: Which part of the email is formal and correct?
qs.why: 正式邮件用 Dear Ms. / Mr. + 姓开头，用 Best wishes 结尾，不用 Hi friend 或 See you later。

dialogues.title: My Fitness Tracker
dialogues.zh: 伟和艾玛聊运动手环记录的生活数据
lines: Is that a new fitness tracker?
Yes! It knows everything about my day. I take about 8,000 steps a day.
是啊！它知道我一天的一切。我每天大概走八千步。
Not bad. How many hours do you sleep?
Only six. I usually go to bed late because I have calls with China.
只有六个小时。我通常睡得晚，因为要和中国那边通话。
That's not much. Do you exercise?
Not really. But I do a lot of housework. I do the laundry and the cooking.
不怎么运动。不过我做很多家务，洗衣服、做饭都是我。
What about your roommate? Does he do the dishes?
No, he doesn't do anything! He never makes his bed, either.
不，他什么都不做！他连床都不整理。
Ha! Do you have free time this weekend? Let's make plans.
哈！你这周末有空吗？我们约一下吧。
Sure. We can have something to drink on Saturday.
好啊。周六可以一起去喝点东西。

dialogues.title: Sorry, You're Breaking Up
dialogues.zh: 伟和成都的同事视频通话，信号不好
lines: Hi, Linda. Can you hear me now?
你好，琳达。现在能听到我吗？
Sorry, you're breaking up. Are you still there?
抱歉，你的声音断断续续的。你还在吗？
Yes, still here. But there's an echo now.
在，还在。不过现在有回声。
OK, wait. Let me turn up the volume. Is that any better?
好，等一下。我把音量调大。好点了吗？
Sorry, I lost you. What was that?
抱歉，刚才听不到了。你说什么？
I said, is that any better?
Not really. I can see you, but I can't hear you very well. Maybe it's my Wi-Fi.
不太好。我能看到你，但听不太清。可能是我的无线网。
The connection's terrible. And I'm running out of battery.
信号太差了。而且我手机快没电了。
My battery is low! Let me call you later, OK?
我快没电了！我待会儿再打给你，好吗？
Fine, let's do that. Talk to you later.

dialogues.title: Which One Is Your Desk?
dialogues.zh: 卡洛斯看伟画的办公室图
lines: Is this a drawing of your office?
Yes, it is. This is my desk, here in the corner.
是的。这是我的桌子，在角落里。
And what are those ones on the round table?
Those are my files. I never look at them!
那些是我的文件。我从来不看！
Ha! Which laptop is yours? This one?
哈！哪台笔记本电脑是你的？这台吗？
No, that one. This one is my boss's.
不，是那台。这台是我老板的。
Where do you usually work? At your desk?
你通常在哪儿工作？在桌子那儿？
Not always. I often work in a café. There's free Wi-Fi, and the coffee is excellent.
不一定。我常在咖啡馆工作，那里有免费无线网，咖啡也很棒。
Yes, there's one under my favorite table.
有，我最喜欢的那张桌子下面就有一个。

vocab.cat: Expressions with do, have, and make
ex: My roommate doesn't do any housework.
我室友一点家务都不做。
vocab.why: I do housework on Saturdays. ## 我周六做家务。

vocab.cat: Expressions with do, have, and make
ex: I do the laundry every Sunday.
我每周日洗衣服。
vocab.why: Who does the laundry in your family? ## 你家谁洗衣服？

vocab.cat: Expressions with do, have, and make
ex: I do the cooking, and my roommate does the dishes.
我做饭，室友洗碗。
vocab.why: Who does the cooking at home? ## 家里谁做饭？

vocab.cat: Expressions with do, have, and make
ex: I usually do the dishes after dinner.
我通常晚饭后洗碗。
vocab.why: Can you do the dishes tonight? ## 今晚你能洗碗吗？

vocab.cat: Expressions with do, have, and make
ex: I do one hour of homework every evening.
我每天晚上做一小时作业。
vocab.why: Do you do your homework at the library? ## 你在图书馆做作业吗？

vocab.cat: Expressions with do, have, and make
ex: I do a lot of work on my laptop.
我在笔记本电脑上做很多工作。
vocab.why: She does a lot of work at night. ## 她晚上做很多工作。

vocab.cat: Expressions with do, have, and make
ex: I make the bed every morning.
我每天早上整理床铺。
vocab.why: My son never makes his bed. ## 我儿子从不叠被子。

vocab.cat: Expressions with do, have, and make
ex: I want to make plans with some friends.
我想和几个朋友约一约。
vocab.why: Let's make plans for the weekend. ## 我们来定一下周末的安排吧。

vocab.cat: Expressions with do, have, and make
ex: I make dinner for my family.
我给家人做晚饭。
vocab.why: What are you making for dinner? ## 你晚饭做什么？

vocab.cat: Expressions with do, have, and make
ex: I want to have a party for my birthday.
我想办个生日派对。
vocab.why: We have a party every New Year's Eve. ## 我们每年除夕夜都开派对。

vocab.cat: Expressions with do, have, and make
ex: When I have free time, I chat with friends.
我有空的时候和朋友聊天。
vocab.why: Do you have free time this weekend? ## 你这个周末有空吗？

vocab.cat: Expressions with do, have, and make
ex: I always have a snack after school.
我放学后总要吃点零食。
vocab.why: Let's have a snack. ## 我们吃点东西吧。
vocab.tip: 吃点正餐以外的小东西。

vocab.cat: Expressions with do, have, and make
ex: I want to stop and have something to drink.
我想停下来喝点东西。
vocab.why: Do you want to have something to drink after class? ## 下课后要不要去喝点东西？

vocab.cat: Expressions with do, have, and make
ex: I often have meetings in here.
我常在这里开会。
vocab.why: We have a meeting at ten. ## 我们十点开会。

ex: I write important dates on my calendar.
我把重要的日子写在日历上。
vocab.why: Check the date on the calendar. ## 看看日历上的日期。
vocab.tip: 古罗马人每月第一天要还账，于是有了“账本、日历”。

ex: I can't find my documents.
我找不到我的文件了。
vocab.why: Save the document before you close it. ## 关掉前先保存文档。

ex: All my notes and files are on my laptop.

phrases.reply: Yes, I can hear you fine.

phrases.en: Sorry, I lost you. What was that?

phrases.reply: I said, is that any better?
sim: I lost you there for a few seconds.
phrases.tip: 因为信号断了听不到对方，就说 I lost you。
调整了设备或换了位置后，确认问题解决没有。

phrases.en: Let me turn up the volume.
phrases.tip: Let me… 用来提出“我来……”的解决办法。

phrases.reply: I said, let me call you.
sim: Sorry, can you say that again?
phrases.tip: catch 在这里是“听清”。Could you repeat that? 最礼貌。

phrases.reply: OK. We can try again later.

phrases.en: How often do you do the dishes?
phrases.reply: I do the dishes every evening.
sim: How many hours do you sleep?
When does your day usually start?
你的一天通常几点开始？
phrases.tip: 回答用频率副词（usually / often / never）放在动词前，或用 every day / every evening 放在句末。
one / ones 代替前面说过的名词，避免重复：This table is my favorite → This one is my favorite.

phrases.reply: It's on the card on the table.
sim: Is there a power outlet near here?
phrases.tip: 在美国咖啡馆，密码常写在小票或柜台的卡片上。

grammar.title: 一般现在时：习惯和日常
rows: 肯定

I do the laundry and the cooking.
Julia sleeps six hours a night.
否定

My roommate doesn't do anything.
I don't have much free time.
一般疑问

Do you do the laundry?
Does Julia sleep a lot?
特殊疑问

What does Julia know about her life?
How many steps do you take every day?
How often do you have something to drink?
时间词位置

I usually do housework on Saturdays.
I do the dishes every evening.
grammar.tip: always / usually / often / sometimes / never 放在动词前；every day、every evening、on Saturdays 放在句末。不说 I do usually housework。
grammar.say: I usually do housework on Saturdays. How often do you do the dishes?

grammar.title: this one / that one；these ones / those ones
rows: 单数

This table is my favorite. → This one is my favorite.
Is that one your laptop?
复数

These chairs are small. → These ones are small.
What are those ones on the table?
近和远

this / these：近处的
that / those：远处的
grammar.tip: one 代替单数名词，ones 代替复数名词。this / that / these / those 也可以单独用：This is my desk.
grammar.say: This one is my favorite. What are those ones on the table?

pron.title: 开头的 /h/
pron.explain: 英语 h 是从喉咙轻轻呼出一口气，像对着镜子哈气，不是中文“喝”那样喉咙发紧的音。也不能省掉：hear 省掉 h 就成了 ear（耳朵），hat 省掉就成了 at。点开听，每个词开头都先轻轻哈一口气。 左边有 h，右边没有：hi / eye（眼睛）、hear / ear（耳朵）、his / is、hate / eight（八）、hat / at。

grammarQuiz.q: My roommate ___ the dishes.
grammarQuiz.why: never 放在动词前；roommate 是他，用 does。

grammarQuiz.q: I ___ the bed every morning.
grammarQuiz.why: 整理床铺是 make the bed。

grammarQuiz.q: Can we ___ a snack now? I'm hungry.
grammarQuiz.why: 吃点零食是 have a snack。

grammarQuiz.q: How often ___ she do the laundry?
grammarQuiz.why: she 的疑问句用 does。

grammarQuiz.q: These chairs are small, but ___ are big.
grammarQuiz.why: 复数名词 chairs 用 those ones。

grammarQuiz.q: Which laptop is yours? — That ___.
grammarQuiz.why: 单数名词用 one 代替。

writingTask.title: 写一段对播客的看法
writingTask.task: 听完一期播客（比如讲成功人士习惯的那期），在下面留言：你喜欢什么、不同意什么、你自己的习惯是什么。
writingTask.focus: 表达观点：I think… / In my opinion… / I don't agree with… 再用 because 说出理由。用一般现在时写你的习惯，频率副词放在动词前。
checklist: 开头说了你对播客的总体感受
用 I think / In my opinion 说出观点
至少有一个 because 说明理由
写了一个你自己的习惯
频率副词放在动词前
writingTask.model: Great podcast! I think the idea about email is really good. I usually check my email at 7:00 a.m., and then I'm stressed all day. In my opinion, reading every day is not for everyone, because some people work very long hours. But I don't agree with the idea about clothes. I never wear the same clothes two days in a row!

readings.title: Podcast: Habits of Successful People — Listener comments
readings.text:
Today's episode: What do successful people do every day? Our guest says they have simple habits. Some of them wear the same clothes every day, so they don't need to choose. Many of them get up early and exercise before work. They read a lot, and they don't check email first thing in the morning. What do you think? Leave a comment!

maria_from_denver: I love this episode! I get up at 5:30 and run every morning, and my days are great. I don't think the clothes idea is for me, though. I like fashion!

wei_seattle: Good podcast, but I don't agree with everything. I'm not a morning person. I do my best work at night, and that's OK. In my opinion, the important thing is to have a plan for your day.

nurse_jamal: Interesting, but these people have a lot of help at home. I work twelve hours a day, and I do the cooking and the laundry. I don't have time to read a book every day!
readings.zh:
本期节目：成功人士每天都做什么？我们的嘉宾说，他们有一些简单的习惯。有些人每天穿一样的衣服，这样就不用挑。很多人早起，上班前锻炼。他们读很多书，而且早上第一件事不是查邮件。你怎么看？留个言吧！

maria_from_denver：我超喜欢这一期！我每天 5:30 起床跑步，每天都过得很棒。不过穿同样衣服这个主意不适合我，我喜欢时尚！

wei_seattle：播客不错，但我不是全都同意。我不是早起的人，我晚上工作效率最高，这也没问题。我觉得重要的是给一天做个计划。

nurse_jamal：挺有意思，但这些人家里有很多人帮忙。我一天工作十二个小时，还要做饭、洗衣服。我可没时间每天读一本书！

opts: They wear the same clothes every day.
They check email first thing in the morning.
They sleep ten hours a night.

qs.why: "Some of them wear the same clothes every day…"

He has a lot of help at home.
qs.a: He does his best work at night.
qs.why: "I'm not a morning person. I do my best work at night…"

qs.q: What does Maria do every morning?
qs.why: "I get up at 5:30 and run every morning…"

qs.a: He works long hours and does housework.

dialogues.title: We're Winning!
dialogues.zh: 伟在看球赛，卡洛斯打电话来
lines: Hey, Wei! Where are you? It's really noisy.
I'm at the stadium! The Sounders are playing.
我在球场！海湾人队在比赛。
Yes! It's 1–0. The fans are going crazy.

The other team is attacking. Wait... it's not a goal! No goal!

dialogues.title: Do You Exercise Much?
dialogues.zh: 伟和艾玛聊锻炼习惯
lines: Well, I stretch every morning, and I climb the stairs at work.
嗯，我每天早上拉伸，上班爬楼梯。
That's a start! I go to the gym three times a week.
那也算开始了！我每周去三次健身房。

Wow. Are you going to the gym today?
No, I'm not. I'm training for a race this month, so today I'm running in the park.
不去。我这个月要准备一场赛跑，所以今天在公园跑步。

好，不过我得先从沙发上站起来！

dialogues.title: Could You Tell Me...?

lines: Excuse me. I'm looking for the fitness class.
打扰一下，我在找健身课。
Sure. It's on the second floor. Take the stairs. The elevator's out of order.
好的。在二楼。请走楼梯，电梯坏了。
Ah, OK. Got it. Could you tell me what time the class finishes?

It finishes at nine, I think.
Great. Just one more thing. Do you know where I can get some water?
太好了。还有一件事，您知道哪儿能买到水吗？

grammar.title: 现在进行时
rows: 肯定

It's getting hot here.
Uruguay is winning!
I'm lifting my coffee cup.
否定

The world number one isn't playing well today.
I'm not going to the gym today.
疑问

What is he doing now?
Are they winning?
— Yes, they are. / No, they're not.
grammar.tip: 现在进行时 = am / is / are + 动词 -ing，说此刻正在发生的事。不说 I'm watch the game，要说 I'm watching the game。
grammar.say: Uruguay is winning! What is he doing now? He's leaving the court.

grammar.title: 一般现在时和现在进行时
rows: 一般现在时：平时、习惯

I stretch every morning.
Do you exercise much?
He comes from Brazil.
现在进行时：此刻、这段时间

He's jumping right now.
Right now he's living in Spain.
I'm training for a race this month.
常搭配的词

一般现在时：every day, usually, often
现在进行时：now, right now, today, this month
grammar.tip: like、know、want、need 这类表示状态的动词一般不用进行时：I know that name（不说 I'm knowing）。
grammar.say: I stretch every morning, but right now I'm lifting my coffee cup.

pron.title: /oʊ/ 和 /ɔː/
pron.explain: /oʊ/ 是滑动的双元音，从“欧”滑到“乌”，嘴唇越来越圆，像 know、coat。/ɔː/ 是一个长音，嘴张大一点、不滑动，像 store、walk。中国学生常把两个都读成“欧”。左边的词嘴唇要收圆，右边的词嘴巴张开不动。

grammarQuiz.q: She ___ to the gym every Monday.
grammarQuiz.why: every Monday 是习惯，用一般现在时。

grammarQuiz.q: Could you tell me where ___?
grammarQuiz.why: Could you tell me 后面用陈述语序。

grammarQuiz.q: What ___ right now?
grammarQuiz.why: right now 用现在进行时，疑问句把 is 提前。

grammarQuiz.why: know 是状态动词，不用进行时。

readings.title: CityRide Seattle — Questions and messages
readings.text:
CityRide is Seattle's bike-sharing program. Take a bike from one of our 200 stations, ride it, and leave it at any other station. It's healthy, cheap, and fast! A single ride costs $2.50 for 30 minutes. A day pass costs $10, and a monthly pass is only $15.

Messages to CityRide

From: Wei Z.
Hi CityRide, I'm trying to rent a bike at the station on Pine Street, but the screen isn't working. Could you tell me where the nearest station is? Thanks!

CityRide: Hi Wei, sorry about that! The nearest station is on 3rd Avenue, two blocks away. We're sending someone to fix the screen now.

From: Rosa M.
Hello, I have a monthly pass. Do you know if I can take a bike on the weekend, too? I'm visiting my sister in Tacoma this Saturday.

CityRide: Hi Rosa! Yes, you can use your pass every day. But our stations are only in Seattle, so you can't leave the bike in Tacoma.

From: Tom B.
The bikes are great, but the helmets aren't! Are you planning to change them?
readings.zh:
CityRide 是西雅图的共享单车项目。从我们 200 个站点中的任意一个取车，骑完放到任何其他站点就行。健康、便宜又快！单次骑行 30 分钟 2.5 美元，日票 10 美元，月票只要 15 美元。

来自：伟 Z.
你好 CityRide，我正在派恩街的站点租车，但屏幕不工作。能告诉我最近的站点在哪儿吗？谢谢！

CityRide：你好伟，很抱歉！最近的站点在第三大道，离这儿两个街区。我们现在就派人去修屏幕。

来自：罗莎 M.
你好，我有月票。请问周末也能骑车吗？这周六我要去塔科马看我姐姐。

CityRide：你好罗莎！可以，月票每天都能用。不过我们的站点只在西雅图，所以不能把车留在塔科马。

车很好，可头盔不行！你们打算换吗？

dialogues.title: What Are You Doing on Saturday?
dialogues.zh: 艾玛和伟聊周末安排
lines: What are you doing on Saturday?
I'm going to Comic Con! Jake and I have new costumes.
我要去动漫展！杰克和我有新的装扮服装。
No way! What are you wearing?
It's a secret. But I'm bringing my camera, so you can see the photos later.
保密。不过我会带相机，你之后能看到照片。
Yes! Some actors and directors from my favorite TV show are coming.
要！我最喜欢那部电视剧的几个演员和导演会来。
That sounds fun. We're going to the music festival in the afternoon.
听起来很好玩。我们下午去音乐节。
真的吗？卡洛斯的乐队演出吗？
Yes, at 8:30, on the new music stage.
是的，八点半，在新的音乐舞台。
Oh, no! We're not staying that long. Comic Con finishes at nine.
哦，不！我们待不到那么晚，动漫展九点才结束。

dialogues.title: The Perfect Gift
dialogues.zh: 伟不知道给妈妈和同事送什么
lines: It's really difficult to find a gift for my mom.
She always tells me she doesn't want anything.
她总跟我说什么都不要。
Ha! My dad says that, too. I usually get him something boring, like socks.
哈！我爸爸也这么说。我通常送他些无聊的东西，比如袜子。
I sometimes buy her perfume, but she never uses it.
我有时给她买香水，可她从来不用。
How about a gift card? Then she can choose.
送礼品卡怎么样？她可以自己挑。
Good idea. And my boss is leaving next week. What can I get her?
好主意。还有我老板下周要离职了，我能送她什么？
A bouquet of flowers. Who doesn't like flowers?
Perfect. Thanks! I'm buying them tomorrow.
太好了。谢谢！我明天去买。

dialogues.title: Would You Like to Come?
dialogues.zh: 卡洛斯约伟去街头节，伟一开始说没空
lines: Hey, Wei, are you doing anything later? We're going to the street festival downtown. Would you like to come?
嘿，伟，你待会儿有事吗？我们要去市中心的街头节，想一起去吗？
Oh, sorry, Carlos, I can't. I wish I could, but I'm working on a report.
哦，抱歉卡洛斯，我去不了。真希望能去，可我在赶一份报告。
Come on! You can work on it later.
That's true. OK. I'd love to.
Great! We can meet you at three at the subway station.
太好了！我们三点在地铁站等你。
Sorry, Wei, we're running late. Let's meet at the new pizza place on Third Street.
抱歉伟，我们要迟到了。我们在第三街那家新开的披萨店见吧。
No problem. See you soon, guys.
没问题。一会儿见，伙计们。

ex: You can meet some of the actors from the movies.

vocab.why: He's my favorite actor. ## 他是我最喜欢的演员。

ex: The artist paints these pictures.
这位画家画了这些画。
vocab.why: Tommy is an artist. ## 汤米是艺术家。

ex: My brother's band is playing tonight.

ex: We're going to the concert in the park.
我们要去公园听音乐会。
vocab.why: The concert starts at eight. ## 音乐会八点开始。

ex: He's a famous movie director.
他是有名的电影导演。

ex: Every year we have a three-day music festival.

phrases.tip: 邀请之前先问对方有没有安排，用现在进行时表示将来的计划。

sim: Do you want to come with us?
Would you like to join us?
phrases.tip: Would you like to… 是礼貌的邀请；对熟人说 Do you want to… 也可以。

phrases.en: Sorry, I can't. I wish I could, but I'm working.
phrases.zh: 抱歉，我去不了。真希望能去，可我要工作。
sim: Thanks, but I can't make it.
phrases.tip: 拒绝时先道歉，再说一个原因，听起来更礼貌。

phrases.en: I don't know. I have homework and stuff.
phrases.zh: 不好说，我有作业什么的。
sim: I have family visiting and things.

phrases.tip: 不想去又不想说太具体，就在原因后面加 and stuff / and things / and everything。

sim: Let's meet at the pizza place.

phrases.tip: 定时间地点：at + 时间，at + 地点。

phrases.tip: running late = 比约定时间晚，美国人约见面迟到时一定会先发消息说这句。
约好地点后道别用 See you there。

sim: Why don't you get her flowers?
phrases.tip: How about + 名词 / 动词 -ing，用来提建议。

phrases.en: Thank you, it's beautiful. I really like it!
phrases.tip: like 后面一定要有宾语：I really like it（不说 I really like）。美国人收到礼物常当面打开并道谢。

grammar.title: 现在进行时表示将来的计划
rows: 肯定

Comic Con is coming this weekend.
I'm bringing my camera.
否定
We're not staying that long.
疑问

Are you going to Comic Con?
What are you doing on Saturday?
常用时间词
tonight, tomorrow, this weekend, on Saturday, next week
grammar.tip: 已经安排好的计划（买了票、约好了人）可以用现在进行时表示将来，常和时间词一起用。
grammar.say: What are you doing on Saturday? I'm going to Comic Con.

grammar.title: 宾格代词
rows: 主格 → 宾格

I → me　you → you　he → him　she → her
it → it　we → us　they → them
放在动词后

He always tells me he doesn't want anything.
I usually get him something boring.
放在介词后

Mom never knows what gifts to get for me.
We're asking them for gift cards.
grammar.tip: like、love 后面要有宾语：I really like it.（不说 I really like.）物品用 it / them，人用 me / him / her / us / them。
grammar.say: I usually get him something boring. She never likes them.

pron.title: 单词中间的 /v/
pron.explain: /v/ 要用上门牙轻轻碰下嘴唇，同时声带振动，像咬着嘴唇发“乌”。中国学生常读成 /w/（嘴唇圆起来不碰牙），love 听起来像 lowe，every 像 ewery。点开听，单词中间的 v 也要咬唇。

writingTask.title: 写一则网上活动通知
writingTask.task: 为一个活动（生日派对、读书会、社区节日、比赛观赛等）写一则网上通知：时间、地点、价格、有什么活动、要带什么，最后邀请大家参加。
writingTask.focus: 通知要一目了然：用 When / Where / Price 这样的小标题列出关键信息；用现在进行时说已安排好的活动（The band is playing at 8:00）；最后用 Would you like to…? / See you there! 邀请。
starters: What's happening? … is playing / performing at …
checklist: 有吸引人的第一句
列出了时间、地点、价格
用现在进行时说了至少两项安排好的活动
说了要带什么或怎么去
最后发出邀请
writingTask.model:
Come and watch the big game with us!

When: Sunday, 5:00 p.m.
Where: Wei's apartment, 1420 Pine Street, #302
Price: Free! Please bring a snack.

What's happening? We're watching the game on a big screen. Carlos is making tacos, and Emma is bringing her famous cookies.

Would you like to come? Send me a message.
See you there!

readings.title: Lunar New Year Celebration at Green Lake Community Center
readings.text:
Come and celebrate the Lunar New Year with us!

When: Saturday, February 7, 11:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m.
Where: Green Lake Community Center, 7201 East Green Lake Drive, Seattle
Price: Free for everyone. Food tickets are $1 each.

What's happening?
The Seattle Lion Dance Team is performing at noon. After that, local musicians are playing traditional music, and a singer from Chengdu is singing her favorite songs. At 2:00, there's a dumpling class for families. Bring the kids! There are also games, a red lantern art table, and lots of great food.

We're looking for volunteers to help with the event. Would you like to join us? Send an email to events@greenlakecc.org.

Please bring your own water bottle. There's no parking at the center, so take the bus or ride a bike.

See you there!
readings.zh:
来和我们一起庆祝农历新年吧！

时间：2 月 7 日星期六，上午 11 点到下午 4 点
地点：绿湖社区中心，西雅图东绿湖大道 7201 号
价格：所有人免费。美食券每张 1 美元。

有什么活动？
西雅图舞狮队中午表演。之后本地乐手演奏传统音乐，一位来自成都的歌手会唱她最喜欢的歌。下午 2 点有亲子包饺子课，带上孩子来吧！还有游戏、红灯笼手工桌和很多好吃的。

我们正在招募志愿者帮忙办活动，你愿意加入吗？请发邮件到 events@greenlakecc.org。

请自带水瓶。中心没有停车位，请乘公交或骑车前来。

到时见！

dialogues.title: My First Day in the U.S.
dialogues.zh: 艾玛问伟刚来美国的第一天
lines: Do you remember your first day in the U.S.?
你还记得刚来美国的第一天吗？
Of course! It was crazy. My flight arrived at midnight.
当然！那天太疯狂了。我的航班半夜才到。
Very tired. And I didn't have any cash for the taxi.
非常累。而且我身上没有现金付出租车钱。
Oh, no! What did you do?
A nice woman at the airport helped me. She called a car for me.
机场一位好心的女士帮了我，她帮我叫了车。
That's amazing. Where did you stay?
In a small hotel. It was really loud, and the bed was horrible!
一家小旅馆。特别吵，床也糟透了！
Ha! Did you sleep at all?
No, I didn't. But the next morning, I saw the ocean for the first time. It was perfect.
没睡着。可第二天早上，我第一次看到了大海，太完美了。

dialogues.title: Guess in 60 Seconds
dialogues.zh: 伟和朋友们玩“60 秒猜名人”

好，我想好了一个名人，你们有 60 秒。
No, she wasn't. She was born in the U.S.
Yes, she did. She graduated from Stanford.
上过。她从斯坦福大学毕业。
No, she didn't. Think about sports...
Was she an athlete? Did she win a medal?
她是运动员吗？她拿过奖牌吗？
Yes! She won three gold medals in the Olympics.
对！她在奥运会上拿了三枚金牌。
She didn't retire. She's still skiing! And... you're out of time!
她没退役，还在滑雪呢！还有……时间到了！

你猜怎么着！我驾照考过了！
Thanks! It was really scary. I almost ran a red light.
谢谢！真吓人，我差点闯了红灯。
But you did really well. I'm proud of you.
可你考得很好。我为你骄傲。
Thanks. How about you? How was your exam?
Oh, no. I failed my chemistry final.
哦，别提了。我化学期末考挂了。
That's terrible! Talk about bad luck.
太倒霉了！真是运气不好。
I know, right? I can't believe this!
Never mind. You can take the class again in the summer. It's not the end of the world.
没关系。你夏天可以再上一次这门课。又不是世界末日。

他 1989 年退休。

ex: He died in 2011.
他 2011 年去世。
vocab.why: My grandfather died when I was ten. ## 我爷爷在我十岁时去世了。

ex: Congratulations! Great job!
恭喜！干得好！
vocab.why: Congratulations on your new job! ## 恭喜你找到新工作！

ex: I'm proud of you.
我为你骄傲。
vocab.why: Her parents are very proud. ## 她父母很自豪。

ex: I failed my chemistry final.
我化学期末考挂了。
vocab.why: I failed by two points! ## 我差两分没及格！

ex: Talk about bad luck!
真是倒霉！
vocab.why: Good luck! ## 祝你好运！

我的第一个故事讲的是一场事故。

phrases.tip: Congratulations 永远带 s，恭喜某事用 on：Congratulations on your wedding!

phrases.reply: Thanks. Not bad for my first time, huh?
phrases.tip: well 是副词，修饰动词 did。不说 You did really good（虽然口语里有人这么说）。
news 不可数，不说 a great news。
别人告诉你坏消息时说，不是道歉。

phrases.en: That's terrible! Talk about bad luck.
phrases.tip: Talk about + 名词 = 真是……，用来加强语气。

phrases.en: Never mind. Don't worry about it.
sim: It's not the end of the world.
phrases.tip: 安慰别人时用，让对方感觉好一点。
美国年轻人常用，表示“我完全同意你说的”。
born 永远和 be 一起用：I was born…（不说 I born…）。

phrases.en: Did you go out last weekend? — Yes, I did.
phrases.zh: 你上周末出去了吗？——出去了。
sim: What did you do last weekend?
phrases.tip: did 后面的动词用原形：Did you go（不说 Did you went）。

phrases.en: You know what? I want to climb another mountain.
phrases.zh: 你知道吗？我还想再爬一座山。
phrases.tip: 要说一个新想法或新消息前，用来吸引对方注意。

grammar.title: 一般过去时（肯定句）
rows: be

It was amazing.
My friends weren't with me.
We were tired.
规则动词 + -ed

visit → visited　stay → stayed
live → lived　study → studied
不规则动词

go → went　have → had　run → ran
hit → hit　buy → bought　meet → met
get → got　become → became
grammar.tip: I / he / she / it 用 was，you / we / they 用 were。不规则动词要一个一个记。
grammar.say: I visited the ocean for the first time. It was amazing. I ran a red light.

grammar.title: 一般过去时：否定和疑问
rows: 否定

He didn't come from Argentina.
I didn't sleep at all.
一般疑问

Did he die in 1989?
— Yes, he did. / No, he didn't.
特殊疑问

When did he retire?
How many children did he have?
Where did you stay?
be 的疑问

Was he an athlete?
Were you tired?
grammar.tip: did / didn't 后面的动词用原形：I didn't study（不说 I didn't studied）。
grammar.say: Did he come from Brazil? Yes, he did. He didn't come from Argentina.

pron.title: 单词重音
pron.explain: 英语多音节词里，有一个音节读得更重、更长、更高，叫重音；其他音节轻轻带过。中国学生常把每个音节读得一样重，听起来像机器人。点开听，重读大写的那个音节，其他音节放轻。

grammarQuiz.q: I ___ the ocean for the first time last year.
grammarQuiz.why: 去年发生的事用过去时，规则动词加 -ed。

grammarQuiz.q: We ___ very tired after the trip.
grammarQuiz.why: we 的过去时 be 用 were。

grammarQuiz.q: He ___ a red light and hit another car.
grammarQuiz.why: run 是不规则动词，过去式 ran。

grammarQuiz.q: I didn't ___ last night.
grammarQuiz.why: didn't 后面用动词原形。

grammarQuiz.q: ___ you go out last weekend?
grammarQuiz.why: 一般过去时的疑问句用 Did。

grammarQuiz.q: When ___ born?
grammarQuiz.why: 出生用 be born，疑问句把 were 提前。

writingTask.title: 在网上留言表示同意或不同意
writingTask.task: 读一篇网上帖子（比如“第一份工作最重要”），写一条留言：先说你同意还是不同意，再用你自己过去的经历说明理由。
writingTask.focus: 表态 + 理由 + 经历：I agree with you / I'm not sure I agree / That's a good point, but…；用一般过去时讲你的经历（My first job was…, I learned…），用 because 说理由。
checklist: 第一句就说明同意或不同意
用一般过去时讲了自己的经历
至少用了一个不规则动词的过去式
用 because 说明理由
语气礼貌
writingTask.model: That's a good point, but I'm not sure I agree. My first job was at a bookstore in Chengdu. It was quiet, and I didn't learn many new skills. I think my second job was more important, because I worked with people from other countries and I learned to speak English.

readings.title: Post: Your first job is the most important job
readings.text:
Posted by Rachel_K:
I think your first job is the most important job in your life. My first job was at a coffee shop in Portland when I was 16. The hours were long, and the customers were sometimes angry. But I learned a lot. I learned to work fast, to smile, and to say sorry. Later, I graduated from college and got a job at a big company, but I still use these skills every day. What do you think?

Comments

mike_88: I agree with you. My first job was at a pizza place, and it was horrible! But it taught me a lot about people.

wei_seattle: I'm not sure I agree. My first job in China was boring, and I didn't learn much. I think my job here in Seattle is more important, because I learned English and met people from many countries.

grandma_joan: That's a good point, Rachel. I started work at 15 and retired at 65. My first boss was strict, but I'm proud of that job. It was the start of everything.
readings.zh:
Rachel_K 发帖：
我认为第一份工作是一生中最重要的工作。我的第一份工作是在波特兰一家咖啡店，那年我 16 岁。工作时间很长，顾客有时还会发脾气。但我学到了很多：学会了动作快、学会了微笑、学会了道歉。后来我大学毕业，进了一家大公司，可这些本领我到现在每天都在用。你们怎么看？

留言

mike_88：我同意你的看法。我的第一份工作在一家披萨店，糟透了！但它教会了我很多与人打交道的事。

wei_seattle：我不太确定我同意。我在中国的第一份工作很无聊，没学到什么。我觉得我在西雅图的这份工作更重要，因为我学了英语，还认识了来自很多国家的人。

grandma_joan：说得有道理，Rachel。我 15 岁开始工作，65 岁退休。我的第一个老板很严格，但我为那份工作感到自豪。那是一切的开始。

units.title: Buy now, pay later
goals: 在商店里描述想要的东西
介绍一个新发明的点子

dialogues.title: Black Friday
dialogues.zh: 伟和卡洛斯计划黑色星期五去购物
lines: Are you going to go shopping on Black Friday?
黑色星期五你要去购物吗？
Yes! I'm going to buy a new TV. I saved for months.
要！我要买台新电视，我存了好几个月的钱。
When are you going to go?
Very early. The first 100 customers get a $50 gift card.
很早去。前 100 位顾客能拿 50 美元礼品卡。
That's crazy! I'm not going to wait in line at 5 a.m.
太疯狂了！我可不会早上五点去排队。
How about you? Are you going to buy anything?
I'm going to shop online. And I'm going to return a shirt. It's too small.
我打算网购。我还要去退一件衬衫，太小了。
Yes. Hey, can you lend me $20? I'll pay you back next week.
有。嘿，你能借我 20 美元吗？我下周还你。
Sure. But don't waste it on candy!
行。不过别都花在糖果上！

dialogues.title: What Do You Call Them in English?
dialogues.zh: 伟在药店找东西，但不知道英文叫什么
lines: Hi, how can I help you?
你好，有什么可以帮你的？
Hello. I'm looking for... um, I don't know the word in English.
你好。我在找……嗯，我不知道英文怎么说。
That's OK. What do you use it for?
没关系。它是用来做什么的？
You cut your nails with them. They're like scissors, but they're just for nails.
用来剪指甲。像剪刀，但只用来剪指甲。
Oh, got it. Nail clippers. They're on the second shelf, over there.
哦，明白了，指甲刀。在那边第二层货架上。
Sorry, what do you call them in English?
Thanks. And one more thing. It's a thing for my charger. You use it in another country.
谢谢。还有一样东西，是用在充电器上的，到别的国家用。
Oh, I get it! An adapter. There's one over there. It works for all countries.
哦，我知道了！转换插头。那边有一个，所有国家都能用。
Great. How much does it cost?
It's on sale this week. Only $12.
这周打折，只要 12 美元。

dialogues.title: Never Shop When You're Hungry
dialogues.zh: 伟去超市只想买鸡蛋，结果买了一大车
lines: Wow, Wei. That's a lot of bags!
I know. I only went to the grocery store to get some eggs.
我知道。我去超市本来只想买鸡蛋。
I was hungry. I put some cheese in my cart because it was on sale.
我饿了。奶酪在打折，我就放了一些进购物车。
Then I saw the desserts. All of them were on the middle shelf.
然后我看到了甜点，全都在中间那层货架上。
Stores put expensive things there because customers look there first.
商店把贵的东西放在那儿，因为顾客先看那儿。
Really? Then I smelled fresh bread, so I bought some, too.
真的吗？后来我闻到新鲜面包，又买了一些。
There were none left! Most of my money is gone, and I have no eggs.
一个都不剩了！钱花了一大半，鸡蛋却没买到。

ex: I even borrow money from friends.
我甚至向朋友借钱。
vocab.why: Can I borrow your charger? ## 能借一下你的充电器吗？

ex: Can you lend me $20?
你能借我 20 美元吗？
vocab.why: I never lend money to friends. ## 我从不借钱给朋友。

ex: I'll pay you back next week.
我下周还你钱。
vocab.why: Did he pay you back? ## 他还你钱了吗？

ex: I save for months and months.
我存了好几个月的钱。
vocab.why: David wants to buy a car, so he saves a lot. ## 大卫想买车，所以存了很多钱。

ex: I usually spend my money on clothes.
我的钱通常花在衣服上。
vocab.why: I like to spend time with my friends. ## 我喜欢和朋友一起度过时间。

ex: She never wastes money on silly things.
她从不把钱浪费在没用的东西上。
vocab.why: Don't waste your time. ## 别浪费时间。

ex: How much does this cost?
这个多少钱？
vocab.why: That phone costs a lot of money. ## 那部手机很贵。

ex: Our store sells a lot on Black Friday.
我们店黑色星期五卖得很多。
vocab.why: They sell everything early. ## 他们很早就卖光了。

ex: I came here to return a shirt.
我来这儿退一件衬衫。
vocab.why: Can I return it without the receipt? ## 没有小票能退吗？

ex: We're going to shop online in the future.
我们以后要网购。
vocab.why: Where do you like to shop online? ## 你喜欢在哪儿网购？

ex: I now had many items in my cart.
我的购物车里已经有很多东西了。
vocab.why: Put it in the shopping cart. ## 把它放进购物车。

ex: The salesperson is at the cash register.
售货员在收银机那儿。
vocab.why: Pay at the cash register. ## 在收银台付钱。

ex: On the way to the checkout, I counted 12 things.
去结账的路上，我数了一下有 12 样东西。
vocab.why: The line at the checkout is long. ## 收银台排的队很长。

ex: Stores know what customers look at first.
商店知道顾客先看哪儿。
vocab.why: The first 100 customers get a gift card. ## 前 100 位顾客能拿到礼品卡。
vocab.tip: 习惯来这儿买东西的人。

ex: Macy's is a famous department store.
梅西百货是有名的百货商店。
vocab.why: The department store has seven floors. ## 这家百货商店有七层。

ex: Never go to the grocery store when you're hungry!
饿的时候千万别去超市！
vocab.why: I go grocery shopping most weekends. ## 我大多数周末去买菜。

ex: Do you know the price of this shirt?
你知道这件衬衫多少钱吗？
vocab.why: The prices here are good. ## 这里价格不错。

ex: The cheese was on sale.
奶酪在打折。
vocab.why: It's a 24-hour sale! ## 24 小时大促！

ex: Ask the salesperson for help.
请售货员帮忙。
vocab.why: She's a salesperson at a department store. ## 她是百货商店的售货员。

ex: All the desserts were on the middle shelf.
所有甜点都在中间那层货架上。
vocab.why: There were no eggs left on the shelf. ## 货架上的鸡蛋都卖光了。

ex: Stores put their sale items on the right.
商店把打折商品放在右边。
vocab.why: How many items do you have? ## 你有几件商品？

ex: Oh, you mean scissors?
哦，你是说剪刀？
vocab.why: Can I borrow your scissors? ## 能借一下你的剪刀吗？

ex: They're like scissors, but they're just for nails.
它们像剪刀，但只用来剪指甲。
vocab.why: Do you have nail clippers? ## 你们有指甲刀吗？

ex: You use it to connect the power cord to the electricity in another country.
在别的国家用它把电源线接到电上。
vocab.why: I need an adapter for Europe. ## 我需要一个欧洲用的转换插头。
vocab.tip: 让插头适应别的插座的东西。

ex: Is it a cable for my phone?
是我手机的数据线吗？
vocab.why: I need a longer cable. ## 我需要一根长一点的线。

ex: Present an idea for a new invention.
介绍一个新发明的点子。
vocab.why: The phone is a great invention. ## 手机是个伟大的发明。

phrases.en: I don't know the word in English.
phrases.reply: That's OK. What do you use it for?
phrases.tip: 想不起单词时别停下来，直接说这句，再描述那个东西。

phrases.en: You use it to connect your charger to the electricity.
sim: You cut your nails with them.
It's a thing for my phone.
phrases.tip: 描述用途：You use it to + 动词 / You … with it。

phrases.en: They're like scissors, but they're just for nails.
phrases.zh: 它们像剪刀，但只用来剪指甲。
sim: It's like a cable, but shorter.
It looks like a small box.
phrases.tip: 用一个你知道的词来比：It's like… but…

phrases.en: What do you call them in English?
sim: How do you say that in English?
phrases.tip: 学新词的好问题，问完记得重复一遍对方的回答。
猜对方想说的词，用来确认。
get 在口语里可以表示“明白”。
cost 的主语是东西：It costs $12。

phrases.en: Can I return this without the receipt?
sim: I'd like to return this shirt.
phrases.tip: 在美国退货很普遍，但通常要带小票，而且有期限（比如 30 天）。

phrases.en: Can you lend me $20? I'll pay you back.
phrases.zh: 你能借我 20 美元吗？我会还你的。
sim: I'll pay you back next week.
phrases.tip: lend 是借给别人，borrow 是从别人那儿借：Can you lend me…? = Can I borrow…?

phrases.en: This year I'm going to buy a TV.
phrases.reply: Nice! Where are you going to buy it?
sim: I'm not going to spend over $200.
我不打算花超过 200 美元
phrases.tip: be going to + 动词原形，说已经决定好的打算。

grammar.title: be going to 表示打算
rows: 肯定

This year I'm going to buy a TV.
We're going to shop online in the future.
否定
We're not going to come back next year.
疑问

Are you going to buy that?
When are you going to go?
grammar.tip: be going to + 动词原形，表示已经决定好的打算。别漏掉 be：I'm going to sell my house（不说 I going to…）。
grammar.say: This year I'm going to buy a TV. We're not going to come back next year.

grammar.title: 限定词：all / most / many / some / no / none
rows: 从多到少
all → most → many → some → no / none
+ 复数名词（泛指）

I go grocery shopping most weekends.
I now had many items in my cart.
I counted 12 things, but no eggs.
+ of the / of them（特指）

All of them were on the middle shelf.
Most of the customers look there first.
There were none left. / None of the eggs were left.
grammar.tip: 泛指直接加名词：some eggs；特指要加 of the / of + 宾格：some of the eggs、all of us。no 后面跟名词，none 单独用：no eggs / none left。
grammar.say: All of them were on the middle shelf. There were none left.

pron.title: 重读重要的词，弱读虚词
pron.explain: 英语句子里，名词、动词、形容词这些带信息的词读得重、清楚；a、the、to、of、can、for 这些虚词读得又轻又快，常常只剩一个“呃”音。中国学生常把每个词都读得一样重。点开听：大写的词重读，其他词轻轻带过。
list: I'm going to buy a TV.
I'm going to BUY a TV.
It's a thing for my phone.
It's a THING for my PHONE.
Most of them were on sale.
MOST of them were on SALE.

grammarQuiz.q: I ___ sell my car next month.
grammarQuiz.why: be going to + 动词原形，be 不能省。

grammarQuiz.q: ___ you going to buy that?
grammarQuiz.why: you 用 are，疑问句把 are 提前。

grammarQuiz.q: Can you ___ me $20?
grammarQuiz.why: 借给别人用 lend。

grammarQuiz.q: I want to ___ this shirt. It's too small.
grammarQuiz.why: 退货用 return。

grammarQuiz.q: I counted 12 things, but ___ eggs.
grammarQuiz.why: no + 名词；none 单独用或用 none of。

grammarQuiz.q: ___ of them were on the middle shelf.
grammarQuiz.why: all of them = 它们全都。

writingTask.title: 写一段视频博客（vlog）脚本
writingTask.task: 为一段关于购物或用钱的短视频写脚本：开场打招呼，说说你的问题或经历，讲讲接下来的打算，最后请观众留言。
writingTask.focus: vlog 脚本分几段：[Intro] 打招呼、介绍话题；[Main] 讲经历（一般过去时）和打算（be going to）；[Outro] 提问、请观众留言、说再见。像对朋友说话一样自然。
starters: [Intro] Hi, everyone! Welcome back to my channel.
[Outro] What about you? Leave a comment below!
checklist: 有开场和结尾
用一般过去时讲了经历
用 be going to 说了至少两个打算
用了本单元的用钱词汇（save / spend / waste / return…）
最后向观众提问

[Main]
Last month, I spent $120 on coffee! I bought a latte every morning on the way to work. So this month, I'm going to make coffee at home. I'm not going to waste money at the café, and I'm going to save for a trip to New York.

[Outro]

readings.title: Vlog script: My shopping challenge — one month, no new clothes
readings.text:
[Intro]
Hi, everyone! Welcome back to my channel. I'm Jenna, and today I'm talking about money. Last month, I looked at my bank app, and I was shocked. I spent $400 on clothes! Most of them are still in my closet with the price tags on.

[The challenge]
So, this month I'm going to try a challenge: no new clothes for 30 days. I'm not going to go to the mall, and I'm going to delete my shopping apps. Every time I want to buy something, I'm going to put the money in a savings jar.

[My plan]
I'm also going to sell some of my old clothes online. And I'm going to return two jackets. Yes, I still have the receipts!

[Outro]
What about you? Do you waste money on things you don't need? Are you going to try the challenge with me? Leave a comment below, and see you next week!
readings.zh:
【开场】
大家好！欢迎回到我的频道。我是珍娜，今天聊聊钱。上个月我看了一下银行 App，吓了一跳：我在衣服上花了 400 美元！大部分还挂着价签躺在衣柜里。

【挑战】
所以这个月我要尝试一个挑战：30 天不买新衣服。我不去商场，还要把购物 App 都删掉。每次想买东西，我就把那笔钱放进一个存钱罐。

【我的计划】
我还打算在网上卖掉一些旧衣服，再退掉两件夹克。没错，小票我还留着！

pron.title: /dʒ/ 和 /ɡ/
pron.explain: /dʒ/ 像中文“姬”的声母但嘴唇往前噘，舌头先贴住上牙龈再放开，像 jam、orange。/ɡ/ 是舌根顶住软腭再放开，像 go、burger。字母 g 有时读 /dʒ/（在 e、i、y 前常读 /dʒ/，如 ginger），有时读 /ɡ/。左边读 /dʒ/，右边读 /ɡ/。

writingTask.title: 给网上文章写评论
writingTask.task: 读一篇关于饮食的网上文章（比如“早餐是不是最重要的一餐”），写一条评论：说你同不同意，再说说你自己的饮食习惯。
writingTask.focus: 评论里用本单元的语法：数量词（a lot of / a little / not many / too much）描述你吃多少；动词搭配（I can't stand -ing / I prefer to… / I'd like to try…）说喜好。
starters: Interesting article! I agree / don't agree.
I eat a lot of / a little / not much …
checklist: 说了同意还是不同意
描述了自己的饮食习惯
正确使用了 many / much / a few / a little
至少用了一个 -ing 搭配和一个 to + 动词搭配
语气友好
writingTask.model: Interesting article! I don't agree with everything, though. I usually eat a big breakfast: rice porridge, an egg, and a little pickled vegetable. I can't stand working on an empty stomach. But I don't drink much coffee, and I don't eat many sweet things in the morning. I'd like to try oatmeal with fresh fruit next week.

readings.title: Article: Is breakfast really the most important meal of the day?
readings.text:
For years, doctors told us to eat a big breakfast. But today, many people skip it. In a recent survey, about 25% of Americans said they don't eat breakfast. Some people don't have time, and some people aren't hungry in the morning. Others say they feel better without it.

So, is breakfast important or not? Some doctors say it gives you energy and helps you focus at work or school. But they also say that what you eat is important. A donut and a sweet coffee aren't a good start to the day. Try yogurt with fresh fruit, eggs, or oatmeal instead.

Comments

kevin_runs: I agree! I can't stand running without breakfast. I always eat oatmeal with a little peanut butter.

lily_chen: Interesting article, but I don't agree. I'm never hungry in the morning, and I feel fine. I prefer to eat a big lunch.

wei_seattle: In China, breakfast is a big meal! I miss my soy milk and fried dough sticks. Here I usually just have cereal, but I'd like to try making Chinese breakfast on the weekend.
readings.zh:
多年来，医生一直告诉我们早餐要吃饱。可现在很多人干脆不吃。最近一项调查显示，大约 25% 的美国人说他们不吃早餐。有的人没时间，有的人早上不饿，还有人说不吃反而感觉更好。

那么早餐到底重不重要？一些医生说早餐给你能量，让你在工作或学习时更专注。但他们也说，吃什么很重要。甜甜圈加一杯甜咖啡可不是一天的好开头。试试酸奶加新鲜水果、鸡蛋或燕麦粥吧。

评论

kevin_runs：同意！不吃早餐我可跑不了步。我总是吃燕麦粥加一点花生酱。

lily_chen：文章挺有意思，但我不同意。我早上从来不饿，感觉也很好。我更喜欢午饭吃得丰盛。

wei_seattle：在中国，早餐可是一顿大餐！我想念豆浆和油条。在这儿我通常只吃麦片，不过周末我想试着做中式早餐。

grammar.title: if 和 when
rows: if：如果（不一定发生）

I'm always happy to help if my guests want a local guide.
If you stay in someone's home, you get a good idea of life there.
when：每当（一定会发生）

When I'm with my guests, I always have a good time.

I'm studying English for my job.

Moving to Chengdu is exciting, but the food is very spicy! Here's my advice for newcomers.

1. Get a WeChat account. You need it to pay for almost everything.

readings.book: 8.4 Advice on living in another country
readings.title: Five tips for your first year in the U.S.
readings.text:
Moving to a new country is exciting, but it isn't always easy. I moved to Seattle from Chengdu two years ago. Here's my advice for newcomers.

1. Get a transit card. If you live in a big city, you don't need a car. Buy an ORCA card to pay for buses and trains. When you get on the bus, just tap it.

2. Learn to make small talk. Americans often talk about the weather or the weekend with people they don't know. If someone asks "How's it going?", just say "Good, thanks. You?" It's not a real question!

3. Remember to tip. In restaurants, people usually leave 15% to 20% for the server. When you take a taxi, you tip the driver, too.

4. Explore your neighborhood. Go to the library to get a free card, and visit the farmers market on the weekend to meet your neighbors.

5. Don't be shy. If you don't understand something, ask! Most people are happy to help.
readings.zh:
搬到一个新国家很兴奋，但并不总是容易。我两年前从成都搬到西雅图，下面是我给新来者的建议。

1. 办一张交通卡。如果你住在大城市，不需要车。买一张 ORCA 卡坐公交和火车，上车时刷一下就行。

2. 学会闲聊。美国人常和不认识的人聊天气或周末。如果有人问 "How's it going?"，就说 "Good, thanks. You?" 那不是真的在问你！

3. 记得给小费。在餐厅，人们通常给服务员 15% 到 20%。坐出租车也要给司机小费。

4. 逛逛你的街区。去图书馆办一张免费借书卡，周末去农夫市集，认识一下邻居。

5. 别害羞。有不懂的就问！大多数人都乐意帮忙。

grammar.title: 比较级
rows: 短形容词 + -er

cold → colder　wet → wetter
windy → windier　friendly → friendlier
长形容词：more / less

more modern　more interesting
less formal　less expensive
不规则
good → better　bad → worse
和 than 一起

The weather is worse than at home.
Everything is more modern than at my old office.
grammar.tip: more 和 -er 不能一起用：better（不说 more better）。加强语气用 a lot / much：a lot less formal、much warmer。
grammar.say: The weather is worse than at home. The dress code is a lot less formal.

grammar.title: 最高级
rows: 短形容词：the + -est

cute → the cutest　young → the youngest
funny → the funniest　big → the biggest
长形容词：the most / the least

the most sensitive child
the most fashionable store
不规则
good → the best　bad → the worst
常用搭配

the best one of all
the youngest boy in the class
grammar.tip: 比较三个或三个以上用最高级，前面要加 the。范围用 in + 地方 / 群体，或 of + 复数：in the class、of all。
grammar.say: Isn't he the cutest little baby? This is the best one of all.

pron.title: /ɝ/ 的音
pron.explain: /ɝ/ 是美式英语特有的卷舌元音：嘴巴半开，舌头往后卷、舌尖不碰任何地方，发出“儿”一样的音。shirt、work、her、first 里都是这个音，拼写可以是 ir、er、ur、or、ear。中国学生常读成“饿”，或者卷舌不够。点开听，整个音都要保持卷舌。

writingTask.title: 写一段描述照片的文字
writingTask.task: 选一张对你有意义的照片，描述它：在哪儿拍的、照片里有谁、他们长什么样、穿什么、在做什么，最后说说为什么这张照片对你很重要。
writingTask.focus: 按位置描述：In the middle / On the left / On the right / In the background；外貌用 has（He has gray hair），穿着用现在进行时（She's wearing…）；用比较级和最高级让描述更生动（the oldest person, brighter than…）。
starters: This is my favorite photo. … took it …
In the middle, you can see …
On the left / On the right is …
He / She has … hair, and he / she's wearing …
checklist: 说了照片在哪儿、什么时候拍的
用了表示位置的短语
描述了外貌（has）和穿着（is wearing）
至少用了一个比较级和一个最高级
最后说了这张照片为什么重要
writingTask.model:
This is my favorite photo. My friend Emma took it at Comic Con last year.

In the middle, you can see me and my coworker Jake. We're wearing superhero costumes. Jake is taller than me, and he has a fake beard. On the left, there's a famous actor from my favorite TV show. He's wearing a black jacket and sunglasses.

It's not the best photo of me, but it's the funniest one, and it was the most exciting day of my year.

readings.title: My favorite photo: Three generations at the beach
readings.text:
This is my favorite photo. My cousin took it last summer at Alki Beach in West Seattle. It's not the most beautiful photo, but it's the most important one for me.

In the middle, you can see my grandfather. He's the oldest person in the picture. He's 82, and he has gray hair and a big white mustache. He's wearing his favorite hat, a very old one with a blue band. He's laughing because my little son is putting sand on his feet.

On the left is my mother. She has short, dark hair, and she's wearing sunglasses and a bright yellow scarf. Her scarf is brighter than the sun! On the right, that's me with the curly hair. I look tired because I drove for three hours that morning.

The weather wasn't perfect. It was cooler and windier than we wanted. But it was the best day of the summer, because it was the first time my grandfather met my son.
readings.zh:
这是我最喜欢的一张照片。去年夏天我表哥在西西雅图的阿尔基海滩拍的。它不是最漂亮的照片，但对我来说是最重要的一张。

中间是我爷爷，照片里年纪最大的人。他 82 岁，满头白发，留着一大撮白色的八字胡。他戴着他最爱的帽子，一顶带蓝色帽带的旧帽子。他在笑，因为我的小儿子正往他脚上堆沙子。

左边是我妈妈。她留着黑色短发，戴着墨镜，围着一条亮黄色的围巾。她的围巾比太阳还亮！右边那个卷头发的是我。我看起来很累，因为那天早上我开了三个小时的车。

grammar.title: have to：必须 / 不必
rows: 肯定

You have to clean your keyboard.
She has to wear gloves all day.
否定（不必）

You don't have to stay home when you have a cold.
He doesn't have to work on Sundays.
疑问

Do you have to work long hours?
What time does she have to start work?
— Yes, I do. / No, I don't.
grammar.tip: don't have to 是“不必”，不是“不许”。he / she 用 has to / doesn't have to。简答用 do / does：Really? I do.（不说 I have.）

grammar.title: 预测：will / won't / may / might

grammar.tip: will / may / might 后面都用动词原形。probably 放在 will 后面、won't 前面：I'll probably…；I probably won't…

pron.title: 词尾的辅音连缀
pron.explain: 英语词尾常有两三个辅音连在一起，比如 chest 的 /st/、ankle 里的 /ŋk/、blocked 的 /kt/。中国学生常在中间或最后加一个元音（chest 读成 chest-e），或者干脆省掉一个（desk 读成 des）。点开听，几个辅音紧紧连在一起，最后不要加“呃”。

writingTask.title: 给未来的自己写一封邮件
writingTask.task: 给五年后的自己写一封邮件：说说你现在的生活和工作，对未来做几个预测，最后提醒未来的自己几件必须做和不必做的事。
writingTask.focus: 预测：will / won't 表示有把握，may / might / maybe / probably 表示不确定；提醒：You have to… / You don't have to…；用 Dear Future … 开头、Love, … 结尾。
starters: Today is …, and I'm writing this email to you.
Please remember: You have to … You don't have to …
checklist: 说了现在的生活或工作
至少两个用 will / won't 的预测
至少两个用 may / might 的预测
用 have to 和 don't have to 提醒自己
有开头称呼和结尾署名
writingTask.model:
Dear Future Me,

Today is my first day at English class. Right now, I can only say a few sentences. You will probably speak English much better. You might travel to New York, and maybe you'll have a job in an international company.

Please remember: You have to study a little every day. You don't have to be perfect.

Love,
Me

readings.title: To: Me, five years from now
readings.text:
Dear Future Wei,

Today is my 30th birthday, and I'm writing this email to you. You will read it in five years, when you are 35. I wonder what your life is like!

Right now, I'm a project manager at a tech company in Seattle. I like my job, but I have to work long hours, and I often have headaches from the stress. I hope you don't have to work so late.

Here are my predictions for you. You will probably speak English very well. You might have your own apartment, and you may have a dog. I don't think you'll live in China again, but you will visit Mom and Dad every year. Maybe you'll have a wife and a baby. That would be amazing!

Please remember these things: You have to exercise and sleep more. You don't have to say yes to every project. And you have to call Grandma every Sunday.

I hope you're happy. Don't forget your 30-year-old self!

Love,
Wei
readings.zh:
亲爱的未来的伟：

今天是我 30 岁生日，我写这封邮件给你。你会在五年后、35 岁时读到它。真想知道你的生活是什么样子！

现在我是西雅图一家科技公司的项目经理。我喜欢我的工作，但得长时间加班，常常因为压力头疼。希望你不用工作到那么晚。

这是我对你的预测：你英语大概会说得很好。你可能有了自己的公寓，也许还养了一条狗。我觉得你不会再回中国住了，但你每年都会回去看爸妈。也许你会有妻子和孩子，那就太好了！

请记住这些事：你得多运动、多睡觉。你不必对每个项目都说好。还有，你每个周日都得给奶奶打电话。

希望你很幸福。别忘了 30 岁的自己！

爱你的
伟

grammar.title: 现在完成时：经历
rows: 构成

have / has + 过去分词
I've made lots of videos.
She's joined three groups.
否定

I haven't bought a car.
I've never built a website.
疑问

Have you ever wanted to go back in time?
— Yes, I have. / No, I haven't.
常见过去分词

make → made　build → built　be → been
run → run　see → seen　buy → bought
grammar.tip: 现在完成时说“有没有过这种经历”，不说具体时间。很多动词的过去分词和过去式一样（made、built），有些不一样（seen、been、run）。
grammar.say: Have you ever built a website? I've never built a website.

grammar.title: 现在完成时和一般过去时
rows: 现在完成时：没说什么时候

Have you ever made a video that went viral?
I've uploaded a lot of videos.
一般过去时：具体时间

When did you make it?
We made it last year.
I dropped it yesterday.
常用搭配

现在完成时：ever, never
一般过去时：yesterday, last year, in 2020, when…
grammar.tip: 有具体时间（yesterday、last year）就要用一般过去时：I made it last year（不说 I've made it last year）。
grammar.say: Have you ever made a video? Yes, I have. I made one last year.

pron.title: 词尾的 /m/ 和 /n/
pron.explain: /m/ 结尾要闭上嘴唇，/n/ 结尾嘴巴微张、舌尖顶住上牙龈。中国学生容易把词尾的 /n/ 读成 /ŋ/（ng），或者把 /m/ 读成 /n/。左边以 /m/ 结尾，右边以 /n/ 结尾，读完注意嘴唇和舌头的位置。

grammarQuiz.why: 现在完成时的疑问句用 Have。

grammarQuiz.why: 有具体时间 last year，用一般过去时。

grammarQuiz.why: Would you mind 后面用 -ing。

grammarQuiz.why: 现在完成时的简答用 haven't。

writingTask.title: 给信息图写评论
writingTask.task: 看一张关于上网习惯的信息图，写一条评论：挑一两个数据，说说你同不同意、你自己的经历，最后给大家一个小建议。
writingTask.focus: 现在完成时说经历（I've never… / I've joined…），一般过去时说具体什么时候（Last week I…）；可以用 I'm not surprised by… / The fact about … is true for me 开头。

最后给了一个建议

I've watched hundreds of cooking videos! Last week I made dumplings from a video, and they were delicious. My advice: use the internet to learn something new.

readings.title: Infographic: How Americans spend time online — and your comments
readings.text:
A day online in the U.S. (average adult)
• Time online: about 7 hours a day
• Time on social media: 2 hours 15 minutes
• Most popular activity: watching videos
• 8 in 10 people check their messages in the first hour after they wake up
• 1 in 3 people have bought something on social media
• 6 in 10 people have changed their password in the last year

Comments

sara_fl: I'm not surprised by the first number. I've worked from home since 2020, so I'm online all day! But I've never bought anything on social media.

grandpa_ed: I'm 75, and I joined my first group last month. I've found three old friends from school! We had a video call on Sunday.

wei_seattle: The fact about messages is true for me. I check my phone before I get out of bed. Yesterday I turned it off for a whole evening, and I read a book. It was great!

tomas_g: Only 6 in 10 have changed their password? That's scary. Change it today, people!
readings.zh:
美国人一天的上网情况（成年人平均）
• 上网时间：每天约 7 小时
• 社交媒体时间：2 小时 15 分钟

评论

dialogues.title: What Was the Weather Like?
dialogues.zh: 艾玛问伟回成都过年的天气
lines: Great! I saw my family and ate a lot of hot pot.
很棒！见了家人，吃了好多火锅。
It was cloudy and foggy most days. Chengdu doesn't see the sun much in winter.
大部分时间多云有雾。成都冬天很少见太阳。
Yes, but it's more humid. And there's no heating in many homes, so it was freezing inside!
是啊，不过更潮湿。而且很多人家没有暖气，屋里冷得要命！
Wow. What's the weather like here this week?
哇。这周这边天气怎么样？
You tell me! You were here.
你告诉我呀！你一直在这儿。
Rainy and windy. There was a big storm with thunder and lightning on Tuesday.
下雨刮风。周二还有一场电闪雷鸣的大暴雨。
So nothing new! What will the weekend be like?
那就是老样子！周末会怎么样？
Sunny, I hope. Let's go to the coast!
希望是晴天。我们去海边吧！

dialogues.title: This Trip Has It All
dialogues.zh: 伟和卡洛斯计划一次华盛顿州自驾游
lines: I found a great trip. It's the place which has everything!
我找到一个很棒的行程，那儿什么都有！
The Olympic Peninsula. There's a rainforest, a coast with tall cliffs, and a glacier.
奥林匹克半岛。有雨林，有高高的悬崖海岸，还有冰川。
华盛顿州有雨林？真的吗？
Yes! It's a rainforest that gets more rain than almost anywhere in the U.S.
真的！那片雨林的降雨量在全美几乎是最多的。
Yes, a few. And there's a guide who takes people to see the caves.
有好几个。还有一位向导带人去看山洞。
Sounds amazing. What's the weather going to be like?
听起来太棒了。天气会怎么样？
Cold and rainy, of course. It's a rainforest!
当然是又冷又下雨，那可是雨林！
OK. I'll bring the umbrella that I bought last year.
好吧。我把去年买的那把伞带上。

dialogues.title: I Think We're Lost
dialogues.zh: 伟和艾玛徒步时迷了路
lines: Excuse me, can you help us, please? We're lost, and my phone just died.
打扰一下，您能帮帮我们吗？我们迷路了，我手机也没电了。
Sure. Where do you want to go?
We're looking for the waterfall. Are we going in the right direction?
我们在找瀑布。我们走的方向对吗？
The waterfall? No, you need to go back the way you came.
瀑布？不对，你们得原路返回。
Oh, no. That's a long way.
The one with the tall tree on top?
山顶上有棵高树的那座？
Yes. Turn left after that hill. No, wait... turn right. Walk for a couple of miles, and you'll see the waterfall on the left.
对。过了那座山左转。不对，等一下……右转。走两英里左右，就能看到左边的瀑布。
Turn right after the hill, and it's on the left. Got it.
过了山右转，瀑布在左边。明白了。

readings.title: How to visit Snoqualmie Falls: A simple guide
readings.text:
Snoqualmie Falls is a beautiful waterfall about 30 miles east of Seattle. It's 268 feet high, which is taller than Niagara Falls! Here's how to plan a perfect visit.

1. Check the weather first. The falls are amazing after a lot of rain, but the paths can be wet and dangerous. In winter, it is sometimes foggy, so you might not see much.

2. Get there early. The parking lot that is closest to the falls fills up fast on weekends. Parking costs $10. If you don't have a car, take a tour bus from downtown Seattle.

3. Start at the top. There's a viewing platform which looks down on the falls. This is the best place to take photos.

4. Walk down the trail to the river. It takes about 20 minutes, and it's steep, so wear good shoes. People who have problems with their legs or back should stay at the top.

5. Have lunch at the lodge. There's a restaurant next to the falls with a great view. Try the famous breakfast. It's served all day!

Don't forget your camera, and enjoy the view!
readings.zh:
斯诺夸尔米瀑布是西雅图以东约 30 英里的一座美丽瀑布。它高 268 英尺，比尼亚加拉瀑布还高！下面教你怎么安排一次完美的游览。

1. 先看天气。下过大雨后的瀑布最壮观，但小路可能湿滑危险。冬天有时有雾，可能看不太清。

2. 早点到。离瀑布最近的停车场周末很快就满了，停车费 10 美元。没有车的话，可以从西雅图市中心坐观光巴士。

3. 从上面开始。有一个俯瞰瀑布的观景台，是拍照的最佳地点。

4. 沿步道走到河边。大约 20 分钟，路很陡，要穿好鞋。腿或背不好的人最好留在上面。

5. 在山庄吃午饭。瀑布旁边有家餐厅，景色很好。尝尝那里有名的早餐，全天供应！

别忘了带相机，好好欣赏风景！
